fault_injections.how: the resolve raises again, so the class cannot even set up - a blunt catch, recorded as one

fault_injections.note: the other three cases pass under it, because they are about the amendment ordering; the differential against the ordinary chain is the only one that sees an invented successor treatment

measured_today.why_not_eleven: The amendment gate answers first and its answer is 'not cleared'. That is a decided policy question whose owner is not this task; the port below is what makes the eleven available the moment it is answered.

the_port_reproduces_the_ordinary_chain_e.how_it_was_checked: The amendment gate was stood down inside one probe process - returning a PROBE_ONLY-marked record, touching no policy file - and all eleven answers were compared field by field with what the ordinary chain says about this registrant.

two_blockers_that_were_independent: An earlier probe stood the amendment gate down and found all eleven coordinates refused again as HISTORICAL_COMPANYFACTS_SUCCESSOR_SCOPE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED, which is what established that the policy question and the successor implementation were two separate pieces of work. This closes the second. Re-running the same stand-down now returns all eleven answers, so that record is superseded by measurement rather than by assertion.
what_changed: Structural applicability is asked before the amendment question. A metric this company's traits exclude reads no input, so no input class can be in doubt for it; five of the eleven were being refused on a classification that cannot reach them.
An approved amendment refusal is carried per metric instead of ending the resolve, and it carries its own reason code and category, so a decided question no longer reads as an unresolved route.

The approved continuity treatment the ordinary route has been running is asked here too: REQUIRE_CONTINUOUS routes report ENTITY_CONTINUITY_NOT_COMPARABLE, current-instant ALLOW routes read this registrant's own facts, and every other successor case keeps the refusal.
what_this_does_not_establish: That the six blocked metrics will resolve. They will not until the Part III amendment question is answered, and that answer changes which inputs a metric accepts, so it is not this task's to give.
Anything about earlier Paramount periods. Period discovery does not cross the subject transition, so only FY2025 resolves today.
Content acceptance of the two values. A frozen Run and a public row say the route computed something and bound its bytes, not that the value is the right value.
